name: preview-picker
title: Preview picker
description: Choose from a list while a preview of the highlighted option sits beside it: templates, email layouts, themes, export formats.
docs: options are { value, label, description?, preview?, disabled? } and the list on the left is a radio group: Tab enters it once; the arrow keys, Home and End move the focus and so preview an option without choosing it; Space, Enter or a click chooses. Pointing at an option previews it as well, and the preview goes back to the chosen one when the pointer leaves. renderPreview(option) draws the preview of the option being previewed; an option can also carry a ready preview node, which can come from a server component. The pane is a labelled region (previewLabel names it), keeps one shape for every option (previewClassName sets it, 4 by 3 by default) so the layout does not jump, never takes the focus, and says in a polite line which option is previewed and which is chosen ("Previewing Minimal, current choice: Classic"). The layout follows the width of the container, not the screen: from 720px the preview sits beside the list, and below it the preview moves under the list behind a Show preview button. A disabled option is skipped by the arrow keys. labels replaces the sentence and the two button names. name sends the chosen value with a plain form.
